Third-party libraries bundled with SPECTRA so that Excel, PDF and Word reading work on any network.
SPECTRA loads these local copies first and only falls back to cdnjs.cloudflare.com if they are missing.

  xlsx.full.min.js        SheetJS Community Edition 0.18.5   Apache License 2.0   (LICENSE-sheetjs.txt)
  pdf.min.js, pdf.worker.min.js   PDF.js 3.11.174 (Mozilla) Apache License 2.0   (LICENSE-pdfjs.txt)
  mammoth.browser.min.js  Mammoth 1.6.0                      BSD 2-Clause         (LICENSE-mammoth.txt)
